name: Porównywarka produktów finansowych
author: kpawliczuk

sections.description:
Porównywarka produktów finansowych is a WordPress plugin that integrates the Bankier.pl affiliate program into your website, allowing you to earn commissions by recommending financial products to your audience.

Bankier.pl is a trusted transactional platform with over 20 years of experience in the Polish financial market. With this plugin you can easily embed financial product widgets — such as cash loans, mortgage loans, savings accounts and more — and monetise your traffic through performance-based commissions.

Key features

  • Access to over 200 advertiser campaigns
  • Performance-based settlements — you pay only for results
  • Campaigns grouped by category for easy browsing
  • Full support from an 8-person publisher support team
  • Over 45,000 satisfied publishers

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API service to function properly. It integrates with the “System Partnerski Bankier.pl” platform (managed by Bonnier Business (Polska) Sp. z o.o.) by making remote requests to the following external endpoint:

  • External API Endpoint: https://api.systempartnerski.pl/publishers/financial-products-api/getdata

  1. Service Description and Purpose
    The connection to this endpoint is required to dynamically retrieve and display current financial product offers (such as personal/business bank accounts, consumer loans, deposits, and mortgages) inside the plugin’s interactive widgets and comparison tools.

  2. Data Transmitted and Request Method
    All external requests to the System Partnerski server are performed exclusively via the GET method. This plugin does not send any data via POST to external servers.

The following technical information is transmitted within the HTTP headers and query strings during GET requests:
* X-Auth-Token (Header) – A unique product-specific API key assigned to the publisher’s account, necessary to authorize the secure connection.
* Plugin-Domain (Header) – The full domain host of your WordPress site, sent solely for authorization verification and publisher statistics.
* Request Parameters (Query String via GET) – Asynchronous user-selected technical filters (e.g., requested loan amount, repayment period, or specific product type IDs) appended to the URL to fetch matching financial offers.

  1. When is Data Transmitted?
    Communication with https://api.systempartnerski.pl occurs in three distinct scenarios:

* Automatically (Once per hour) – WordPress’s internal Cron mechanism (spbi_ks_refresh_api_data) performs a background fetch to refresh the local data cache and ensure product lists remain accurate.
* When saving API settings – When a publisher updates their API keys in the admin panel, the plugin sends an immediate test request to verify the key’s status, validity, and matching product type response.
* Asynchronously (Front-end AJAX) – Upon a visitor’s interaction with the comparison widgets on the front-end, a secure request is initialized to fetch specific financial data based on client filters.

  1. Terms of Use and Privacy Policy
    This external service is provided and governed by Bonnier Business (Polska) Sp. z o.o. Before deploying the plugin, please review the provider’s official legal documents:

* Terms of Service: https://apps.bonnier.pl/regulaminy/pdf/System_Partnerski_Regulamin_31.10.2025.pdf
* Privacy Policy: https://apps.bonnier.pl/img/polityka_prywatnosci_bbp.pdf?utm_source=systempartnerski.pl
* API Documentation: https://api.systempartnerski.pl/publishers/financial-products-api/help

Why choose Porównywarka produktów finansowych?

  • 20 years of market experience
  • Proven transactional platform
  • Guaranteed campaign profitability
  • Professional technical support
  • Wide selection of advertising campaigns
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress plugin panel or upload it manually to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin in the “Plugins” panel.
  3. Configure your account under the “Porównywarka produktów finansowych” menu.
  4. Start earning commissions on recommended products.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin is completely free. You earn commissions from successful transactions.

How quickly will I receive a payout?

Settlements are processed regularly according to the schedule available in the publisher panel.

Do I need experience in affiliate marketing?

No prior experience is required. Our team will help you get started and support you at every stage of the partnership.
